note: `text` is what is spoken; spellings like 'Trust Label' or 'Lot-tuh' only steer Kokoro's pronunciation. `text_elevenlabs` overrides it for ElevenLabs. Cue ids are referenced by the scenes to time their animations.

hook.text: An urgent customer question comes in.
Van Dam Logistics needs to know the overtime cut-off. Today.

problem.text: One was recently updated. One has an owner who left the company. And one might be for another country.
Then a colleague in Teams says something else entirely.
Lot-tuh has found information, but she still can't act with confidence.
problem.text_elevenlabs: Lotte has found information, but she still can't act with confidence.

reveal.text: Search finds it. Trust Label shows whether you can rely on it.
reveal.text_elevenlabs: Search finds it. TrustLabel shows whether you can rely on it.

grading.text: Every source gets a grade from A to G, like an energy label, and every point is explained.
This old handbook starts at seventy-five.
Minus fifteen: its review is five hundred and seventy-seven days overdue.
And a newer procedure replaced it. Grade F.

applicability.text: Applicability is judged separately from quality.
A solid Dutch procedure, grade C, still doesn't apply to a Belgian client.

triage.text: When sources disagree, Trust Label sorts out why.
A client exception, claimed only in chat.
The verdict is honest: don't act yet. The twentieth, grade C, versus the twenty-fifth, grade D.

routing.text: The remaining doubt goes to the best-qualified expert.
Ellen leads the Van Dam account, knows the topic, and owns the evidence.
Client questions never leave the client's team.
One click sends her the question, with every competing value and its grade.

voice.text: Ellen answers with a short voice note.
OpenAI extracts the value and a verbatim quote.
Then the rules check that the quote really is in the transcript, and really states the value.

verified.text: The twenty-fifth. Grade A. Verified by Ellen, valid until March twenty twenty-seven.
And it stays in its context. For Belgium, all clients, the answer is still the twentieth.

team.text: Trust Label was built by our team, for the S D Works challenge at Tectonic twenty twenty-six.
team.text_elevenlabs: TrustLabel was built by our team, for the SD Worx challenge at Tectonic 2026.

outro.text: AI reads. Rules judge. Humans verify.
